searchText: Won’t be able to make the call today but Pawan will be on for LH **4844 call in 30m**: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/686 but geth generally works `--http.port 8545 --authrpc.port 8551` and this is the setting that we run geth with and it worked at this commit although submitting a blob tx to geth resulted in this error: ``` { jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 2, error: { code: -32000, message: 'failed to verify kzg' } } ``` <@360491619402776577> mentioned in the call about taking N iterations on the average case, since the "worse case" changes per run and is not influenced by the input, what do you think? (For the 4844 precompile) <@792822129019584562> or <@403636673914863626> Dan Coffman released v1.0.8 which now includes the verifyKzgProof. I ran that version through the test vectors and it passes, so it should be interopable with go-kzg Awesome! Just saw the update so will incorporate into our code tomorrow and proceed with the remaining bits of the spec we haven't implemented and then test our transaction code against Geth to validate
